nameOfQualification: Secondary and Tertiary Packaging Assistant- (Pharma, Biologics and Medical Devices)
description: The Secondary and Tertiary Packaging Assistant- (Pharma, Biologics and Medical device) supports the packaging team in secondary and tertiary packaging activities by performing a combination of tasks. The job role holder also supports the team in maintaining a healthy, safe and secure environment and disposal of waste packing material as per current Good Manufacturing Practices(cGMP) Guidelines.
awardingBodyName: Life Sciences Sector Skill Development Council
typeOfQualification: General, For ToT, For ToA, Upskilling, Fresh Skilling

leaningUnitGrid.NAME: Coordinate with supervisor, teammates and cross- functional teams
Clean and sanitize work area and machines to avoid cross- contamination
Adhere to Environment, health and safety guidelines in a production facility and GMP controlled areas
Perform the secondary and tertiary packaging of drug products in adherence to current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP) guidelines
Discuss about Life Sciences Industry and basics of Packaging Operations
